answer_value: top row triangle-up above circle; bottom row circle above triangle-down, two columns
steps: Folded right onto left, then top onto bottom; cut in bottom-left quarter is circle above down-pointing triangle.
Unfolding the horizontal fold reflects to top half: up-pointing triangle above circle (triangle farther from fold).
Unfolding vertical fold duplicates to the right column.
A: top row not reflected - fails. B: top row triangles point down - fails. D: top row circle above triangle - fails.
C fits.

answer_value: 3 triangles on left, 2 on bottom, 5 plus signs
